# PharmacyChecker

> > PharmacyChecker helps consumers compare prescription drug prices across U.S. and international online pharmacies while verifying pharmacy safety and accreditation.

PharmacyChecker provides drug price comparisons for medications like Eliquis, Rybelsus, Apoquel, Jardiance, and Xarelto across verified pharmacies in Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and other countries. The platform offers pharmacy verification seals, discount cards, and expert guidance from healthcare professionals including Tod Cooperman, Ross Phan, and Lucia Mueller.

## Key Topics

- Drug price comparison
- Online pharmacy verification
- Prescription savings and discount cards
- International pharmacies (Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India)
- Pharmacy accreditation and safety
- Tier 1 pharmacy certification
- Verification seals
- Medication affordability
- Popular medications (Eliquis, Rybelsus, Apoquel, Jardiance, Xarelto)
- CanadaDrugs.com
- Pharmacist Choice programs
- Boston University School of Medicine affiliations
- Tod Cooperman, Ross Phan, Lucia Mueller

## Drug Price Comparison

- [Drug Price Comparisons & Online Pharmacy Safety | PharmacyChecker.com](https://www.pharmacychecker.com/): Homepage for comparing drug prices and verifying online pharmacy safety
- [Pharmacist Choice Prices - U.S. & International | PharmacyChecker.com](https://www.pharmacychecker.com/es/pharmacist+choice/): Spanish page comparing Pharmacist Choice drug prices with discount coupons
